ExplanationParts.CorpusEarnedOpening: Appraisers repeatedly use the phrase when one party projects his own limitation, value, or position onto somebody else.
EvidenceBody: The phrase marks the mistake of projecting one’s own capacity, value, or position as the measure of another.
